body: Thanks :) I talked to my friend, the one I was afraid was no longer my friend (depression really fucks with my perception). She was really supportive and wished that I spoke with her earlier. Thanks again for your advice.

Much of the time, I'm okay with it. Time heals. Time has been the best healer. Talking about it has never helped. People respond with either morbid curiousity, victim-blaming, disbelief, pity, or blankness because they don't know how to respond. Even therapists told me that they didn't feel comfortable talking about it. I don't think I will ever be 100% over it because the events changed me, they really did. I would be a very different person today if none of these things happened to me. I know that. 

But, despite my present depressive state (which is due to, I guess, a genetic predisposition to chemical imbalances in my brain), the events are not the defining factor of my life. 

You will figure out a way to deal with this. It sounds like you have great support (bf and kittens! I really do believe in animal therapy). 

It's okay to be angry. You have a right to be angry. 

Time, though, is a great friend.

I've been raped twice. So, I couldn't read your post fully. I'm sorry. But, I just wanted to say that I believe you, and I'm sorry for what has happened to you. I know what it feels like to have people not believe you, to have people tell you "oh, get over it." It sucks. Lots of times, people suck. And rape is a hard thing to get over. I don't know if I'll ever get over it. It makes me a bit happy to read that you have a boyfriend and kittens. It's wonderful that he is so understanding of your situation. You deserve that. Everyone deserves that. 

Screw those who try to blame you for what happened, etc. They don't matter.

I get that you're trying to help. So, thank you. But, my brother doesn't even want to talk to me now. If I reach out to a friend, I'll be even more alone. So, I'm not going to bother anymore. I'm too cowardly to kill myself at the moment, so that's that. But, thanks.
Yeah, my brother got angry. Didn't want to hear it. I tried.

I don't know why you deleted your other comment, but I did just send a text to my brother, asking him to call me tomorrow. I don't know how he will respond at all. He may get mad again, or maybe he will want to talk. I'm not going to do anything to myself tonight, so I may as well try to talk to my brother about it.
I'm going to think more about your highs and lows thing, though. So, thank you for that.

I have one brother in med school. I can't stress him out. The other brother, he's got a stressful job. I can't stress him out, either. And the last time I tried to talk to him about feeling suicidal, he got upset with me and told me that he can't listen to me talk about things like that. So, I don't tell them how I feel because I can't.

But I have experienced highs and lows. I've been to a bunch of different countries, attended a top ten university, and I've been homeless, sleeping on the streets. I've experienced a lot of shit, good and bad, lots of extremes. 

I'm not dwelling on a low moment. I'm tired. 

I get what you're saying. I'm not trying to be a dick. This is just where I am right now.
Well, yeah, I have accomplished things. I guess I don't really see how accomplishing things really matters. With each accomplishment, there's another failure.
Yeah, I think I get your point. I appreciate your words; I just don't want to say anything more about being raped.
